column2: Retain Judas called Maccabeus, the son succeeding his father. The repeated pronouns are resolved by the preceding death notice, not a new source name.
Retain all brothers and all who had joined his father, their help and Israel’s war with gladness. The repeated collective scope and affect remain.
Retain expanded glory, breastplate like a giant, equipment and shielding the army with a sword. The four inherited lines preserve the accumulating encomium without explaining away its bodily scale.

Propose roaring for prey for roaring over prey: the directional/purposive phrase points toward the hunt rather than expressly placing captured prey beneath the lion. Keep the two inherited lines and lion/cub parallel.
column3: Does the prey phrase describe hunting purpose, movement toward prey or roaring at prey? The proposed for leaves the result of the hunt unstated.

column2: Retain pursuit with searching and burning the people’s troublers. English searched out and pursued unfolds a participle without claiming two distinct expeditions; separate the two violent actions in display.
Retain lawless shrinking, all workers shaken and deliverance prospering in his hand. The agent of the passive prospering is not expressly named; keep the inherited three-line movement.
Retain embittering many kings, gladdening Jacob and perpetual blessing of his memory. The inherited three lines retain the contrasting emotional verbs and nominal final clause.

Retain cities of Judah, removal of ungodly people out of her and wrath turned from Israel. Her follows the feminine territory reference; no divine possessive is added to wrath. Give the three clauses separate lines.
Retain the earth’s extremity and gathering those perishing, without reducing the latter to a named party or already dead people. Two display lines preserve the paired claims.
Retain Apollonius gathering nations and a great force from Samaria to fight Israel. Do not collapse the two recruitment expressions into one ethnic designation.
Retain Judas’s learning, encounter, striking and killing Apollonius, followed by many wounded and the survivors’ flight. Wounded does not itself establish that every fallen man died.
Retain plural taking of spoils followed by Judas’s individual taking of Apollonius’s sword. All his days preserves the duration without supplying a later death scene.
Retain Seron’s Syrian command and Judas’s gathering/assembly of faithful men going to war. Faithful describes the group without identifying a later religious institution.
Retain Seron’s self-directed name and royal honour, and his characterization of Judas’s men as despising the king’s word. This is the commander’s rationale, not narrator approval.
Retain the inherited set out again provisionally for the elliptical added/proceeded verb, then the strong ungodly army ascending with him. Its help is expressly directed toward vengeance on Israel.
column3: Does the elliptical first verb support renewed departure or simply proceeding? Again is an interpretive idiom here, not an independent Greek adverb.

column2: Retain the ascent of Beth-horon and Judas’s small company. Only a few expresses the marked smallness of the adjective rather than adding an unrelated exclusivity claim.
Retain the soldiers’ question contrasting few with a strong multitude and their exhaustion through not eating that day. No prior fast or duration beyond today is supplied.
Retain many shut into few hands and the equal saving possibilities before Heaven. The passive delivery image is not converted into an assertion of numerical parity.
Retain victory independent of army size and strength from heaven. The contrast concerns the source of strength, without erasing the army or predicting an explicitly numbered outcome.
Retain the abundance of arrogance and lawlessness, destruction of fighters, wives and children, and plunder. Do not merge the two stated purposes.
Retain lives and customs as the objects of their fighting. Lives is contextual for souls here; customs preserves the distinct legal-practice term.
Retain He Himself crushing the enemy and the plural prohibition against fear. The capitalized divine antecedent is inferred from Heaven in verses 18–19, not a divine name in this unit.
Retain sudden attack immediately after speaking and Seron’s army being crushed before Judas. The passive defeat does not name a new acting subject.
Retain pursuit down the descent, about eight hundred fallen and the rest fleeing to Philistine territory. The change from ascent to descent and approximate count remain.
Retain the beginning of fear of Judas and his brothers, followed by terror upon surrounding nations. No unrelated geographical expansion is supplied.
Retain his name reaching the king and the nations recounting Judas’s battles. The Greek singular verb with neuter plural nations does not make the king the reporting subject.
Retain Antiochus’s anger, sending and gathering all his kingdom’s forces into an exceedingly strong army. The forceful affect is naturally expressed by became furious.
Retain the treasury opening, a year’s pay and readiness for every need. No precise currency, campaign length or advance-payment mechanism is invented.
Retain depleted silver, reduced revenues and the disruption the king himself caused by abolishing ancient customs. The causal chain must not excuse his agency by making the disaster independent.
Retain former occasions as an idiomatic rendering of once and twice, lavish gifts and comparison with earlier kings. The fear concerns having enough for both expenses and gifts.
column3: Should the once-and-twice wording remain audible, or is former occasions sufficient for its idiomatic recurrence?

column2: Retain perplexity in his soul and the plan to go to Persia, collect revenues and gather much silver. The three intended actions remain distinct.
Retain Lysias’s honour, royal descent and jurisdiction from the Euphrates to Egypt. Royal lineage is not converted into an unexpressed exact relationship to Antiochus.
Retain responsibility for raising the king’s son Antiochus until the king’s return. The repeated name does not merge father and son; the until clause is retained.
Retain half the forces and the elephants, with the general instruction followed by Judea and Jerusalem. No elephant count or second half is added here.
Retain sending an army to crush/remove Israel’s strength, Jerusalem’s remnant and their memory from the place. The violent program remains attributed to the king’s orders.
Retain settlement of foreigners throughout the territory and allotment of the land. English them makes the contextual beneficiaries explicit without identifying an unstated ethnicity.
Retain the remaining half, departure from royal Antioch, year 147, crossing the Euphrates and the upper countries. No modern calendar conversion or fixed regional equation is imposed.
Retain Lysias’s selection of Ptolemy son of Dorymenes, Nicanor and Gorgias among the royal Friends. Friends is provisionally treated as a court designation, not merely personal affection.
Retain forty thousand men and seven thousand cavalry, Judah as destination and destruction ordered by the king. Collective horse is naturally cavalry here.
Retain singular He set out followed by plural they came and camped, and their force between them. Do not silently regularize the selected subject shift to a plural departure.
column3: Who is the subject of the singular departure? The syntax is retained, while Lysias’s personal presence is not certified.

column2: Retain merchants’ money, gold and shackles, the intended purchase of Israelites as slaves and the additional Syrian/foreign force. The slave-market context supports slaves for the dependent-person term.
Retain the brothers seeing increased evils and encamped armies, then learning the destructive royal orders. Both destruction and an end remain, without making the orders already completed.
Retain restore our people’s fallen state provisionally for the difficult raise-up/downfall combination. The shared resolve and fighting for people and holy places remain.
column3: Does the downfall noun denote the people’s ruin to be reversed, or another object of raising? The inherited restoration wording is interpretive, not an established lexical equivalence.

column2: Retain the assembly’s preparation, prayer and request for mercy and compassion. The two compassion terms are not collapsed into a single abstract petition.

Retain uninhabited Jerusalem, absence of her offspring, trampled sanctuary, foreigners in the citadel and vanished joy/music. Six display lines follow those clauses without moving the lodging phrase away from its immediate setting.
column3: What is the precise attachment of lodging for the nations: citadel, the occupied complex or Jerusalem more broadly?

column2: Retain Mizpah opposite Jerusalem and its former use as Israel’s place of prayer. The inherited place form is provisional against the selected Massepha spelling; no modern site identification is asserted.
Retain fasting that day, sackcloth, ashes on heads and torn garments. These embodied acts remain without importing a formal liturgical rubric.
Retain the difficult law-book/idol-likeness sentence provisionally. The Greek inquiry verb, nations and images are visible in the inherited reading, but its supplied matters is interpretive.
column3: What is the antecedent and construction of concerning which, and are the idol likenesses objects of consultation or searching? No divination procedure or textual emendation is certified.

column2: Retain priestly garments, firstfruits, tithes and bringing forward Nazirites whose days were complete. No unstated offering or completion ceremony is added.

Retain the cry to Heaven and both questions. The final masculine them can point to the Nazirites; these may embrace the wider presented group/things. Display the introduction and two questions separately.
column3: How broad is these, and how narrowly should the masculine them be resolved? The inherited pronouns avoid settling both to one referent.

column2: Retain Thy in the prayer, the profanation of holy places and priests in mourning/humiliation. Two lines preserve the parallel; when is an English contextual link for the Greek coordination.
column3: Does the neuter holy expression encompass holy things as well as places? The spatial rendering remains provisional.

column2: Retain Behold, the assembled nations’ destructive purpose and Thou knowest their plans. Direct address to the divine referent supports the sacred pronoun register; two lines separate threat and appeal.
Retain inability to stand unless Thou help us. The emphatic divine subject and conditional dependence remain without changing the prayer into a prediction.
Retain sounding trumpets and a loud communal cry. The volume and two actions remain; no response from Heaven is invented.
Retain commanders of thousands, hundreds, fifties and tens. The four levels are not merged or recounted as a troop total.
Retain housebuilders, betrothed men, vineyard planters and fearful men returning each home under the law. The four categories remain without adding the content of another biblical passage.
Retain the army’s movement and encampment south of Emmaus. The selected cardinal direction is explicit and is not replaced by a speculative route.
Retain girding, strength, morning readiness and the nations’ purpose to destroy people and holy places. Men of strength naturally expresses sons of strength without asserting literal parentage.
Retain the stated preference for death in battle over witnessing the nation’s and holy places’ evils. The comparative is the speaker’s exhortation, not a generalized rule supplied by the translator.
Retain whatever the will in heaven may be, that He will do. He is an inferred divine subject of the unexpressed Greek verb subject, not a masculine pronoun stated in the source.
column3: Could the elliptical subject refer differently in context? Keep the divine construal provisional and do not claim that verb morphology establishes gender.
